  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Id": "ExamplePermissionsPolicy",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowSESConfiguration",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "ses:SetIdentityDkimEnabled",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::${transfer:HomeDirectory}/file-40-1.txt",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "aws:RequestedRegion": "us-east-1"
        }
      },
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/service-role"
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "DenyUnauthorizedBucketOperationsOnForbiddenBucket",
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": ["s3:GetBucketLocation"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::${transfer:HomeDirectory}-forbidden/file.txt",
      "Condition": {
        "StringLike": {

      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::987654321098:user/charlie"
      }

      "Sid": "AllowWorkspaceManagementByBob",
